source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 3 (PDF 46-73), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Chemical Bonding) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
3.1 Lewis concept of bonding

blocks.prompt:
1 Define chemical bond. Name the types of bonds included in this term.
(Chemical bond ki definition likhein. Is mein kaunse bonds shamil hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chemical bond (kimiyai bandhan) woh force hai jo do ya zyada atoms, molecules ya ions ko jor kar rakhti hai. Is mein ionic, covalent, dative, metallic bonds aur intermolecular (van der Waals) forces shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: A chemical bond is the force that holds together two or more atoms, molecules or ions.

blocks.prompt:
2 Why are van der Waals forces usually not termed pure chemical bonds?
(Van der Waals forces ko aam taur par khalis chemical bonds kyun nahi kaha jata?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh kamzor hoti hain. Yeh molecules ke darmiyan amal karti hain aur nayi species nahi banatin, jab ke asal chemical bonds bahut mazboot hote hain.

book_ref.quote: However, being weak enough, van der Waals forces are usually not termed as pure chemical bonds.

blocks.prompt:
3 State the Lewis concept of bonding.
(Lewis concept of bonding bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Lewis ke mutabiq atoms apni bairooni shell mukammal kar ke noble gas jaisi configuration paane ke liye bonds banate hain. Yeh zyada tar valence shell mein octet (aath electrons) bana kar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Lewis concept of bonding gives a simple explanation of the formation of all types of bonds.

blocks.text: 3.1.1 Ionic bond

blocks.prompt:
4 What is an ionic bond? Explain its formation in NaCl briefly.
(Ionic bond kya hai? NaCl mein is ka banna mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ionic bond kam ionization energy wale atom se zyada electron affinity wale atom ki taraf electrons ki mukammal muntaqili se banta hai. Na (2, 8, 1) aik electron kho kar Na⁺ (2, 8) banta hai; Cl (2, 8, 7) woh electron le kar Cl⁻ (2, 8, 8) banta hai. Mukhalif charge wale ions NaCl crystal mein mazboot ionic bond se jure rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: the ionic bond is formed by the complete transfer of electrons from an atom with low ionization energy

blocks.prompt:
5 Between which groups of elements are ionic bonds expected? Why?
(Kin groups ke elements ke darmiyan ionic bonds mutawaqqa hain? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Group 1 aur 2 ki metals aur group 16 aur 17 ke elements ke darmiyan. Metals ki ionization energy kam hai, woh asaani se electrons khoti hain; group 16 aur 17 ki electron affinity zyada hai, woh electrons leti hain.

book_ref.quote: A similar type of bond is expected between group 1 and 2 metals and groups 16 and 17 elements.

blocks.text: 3.1.2 Covalent bond (electron pair bond)

blocks.prompt:
6 Define covalent bond. How does Cl₂ attain stability?
(Covalent bond ki definition likhein. Cl₂ kaise mustahkam hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Covalent bond do atoms ke darmiyan electrons ki baahmi sharing se banta hai. Cl₂ mein har Cl atom aik electron share karta hai; dono ki valence shell (octet) mukammal ho jaati hai aur qareebi noble gas configuration milti hai.

book_ref.quote: While sharing electrons, each atom completes its valence shell and attains the nearest noble gas configuration.

blocks.prompt:
7 Why is the bond in Cl₂ non-polar while the bond in HCl is polar?
(Cl₂ ka bond non-polar aur HCl ka bond polar kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cl₂ mein dono atoms ki electronegativity bilkul barabar hai, is liye pair barabar share hota hai aur kisi par charge nahi. HCl mein Cl zyada electronegative hai, electron density Cl ki taraf khisak jaati hai, is liye bond polar hai.

book_ref.quote: The electronegativity of the two atoms is exactly the same

blocks.prompt:
8 Differentiate between non-polar and polar covalent bonds.
(Non-polar aur polar covalent bonds mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Non-polar bond barabar electronegativity wale atoms mein, aur polar bond mukhtalif electronegativity wale atoms mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A covalent bond may be non-polar or polar in character.

rows: Barabar electronegativity wale atoms mein.
Mukhtalif electronegativity wale atoms mein.
Bonded atoms barqi taur par neutral rehte hain.
Aik atom par δ⁺ aur doosre par δ⁻.
Misalein: H₂, Cl₂, F₂, Br₂, I₂.
Misalein: H–Cl, H–Br, H₂O.

blocks.text: Dative bond (coordinate covalent bond), printed as 3.13

blocks.prompt:
9 Define dative bond. Name the donor and acceptor in the formation of the hydronium ion.
(Dative bond ki definition likhein. Hydronium ion bante waqt donor aur acceptor kaun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dative (coordinate covalent) bond tab banta hai jab shared electron pair sirf aik bonding atom deta hai. H₃O⁺ mein H₂O ka oxygen (do lone pairs wala) donor aur electron ki kami wala proton H⁺ acceptor hai: H₂O + H⁺ → H₃O⁺.

book_ref.quote: A dative bond is formed between two atoms when the shared pair of electrons is donated by one of the bonding atoms.

blocks.prompt:
10 Why does carbon monoxide contain a dative bond?
(Carbon monoxide mein dative bond kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen aur carbon pehle aam double covalent bond banate hain, magar carbon ka octet adhoora rehta hai; use aik aur pair chahiye. Oxygen apna aik lone pair carbon ko deta hai, yun dative bond banta hai.

book_ref.quote: However, the valency of carbon is not satisfied with these bonds.

blocks.prompt:
11 How is a coordinate covalent bond formed in ozone? Which atoms carry charges?
(Ozone mein coordinate covalent bond kaise banta hai? Kin atoms par charge hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ozone O₂ aur aik azad oxygen atom (O) se banta hai. O₂ ka aik oxygen apna lone pair azad O ko deta hai aur coordinate bond banta hai. Darmiyani O (aik taraf double bond, doosri taraf coordinate bond) par positive aur lene wale O par negative charge hai.

book_ref.quote: It is formed by a reaction between the oxygen molecule with an oxygen atom

blocks.text: 3.1.4 Expanded octet in polyatomic ions

blocks.prompt:
12 What are polyatomic ions? Give two examples with correct charges.
(Polyatomic ions kya hain? Durust charge ke saath do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Polyatomic ions do ya zyada jure hue atoms se bane ions hain (atoms ek hi element ke bhi ho sakte hain, jaise I₃⁻); un ka kul charge un ka formal charge hai. NH₄⁺ ke ilawa yeh aksar negative hain, maslan carbonate CO₃²⁻ aur nitrate NO₃⁻.

book_ref.quote: Polyatomic ions are the ions composed of more than one type of atoms.

blocks.prompt:
13 What is meant by an expanded octet? Give two examples.
(Expanded octet se kya muraad hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Kuch polyatomic ions mein central atom octet rule tor kar apni electron density oonche (d) orbitals tak phaila deta hai aur aath se zyada electrons rakhta hai. Misalein: SO₄²⁻, ClO₄⁻, PO₄³⁻.

book_ref.quote: These are said to have expanded octets.

blocks.prompt:
14 Show that S in SO₄²⁻ exceeds the octet by 4 electrons.
(Dikhayein ke SO₄²⁻ mein S octet se 4 electrons zyada rakhta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Lewis structure mein S ke do double aur do single bonds hain. Valence electrons = 2(4) + 2(2) = 12. 12 − 8 = 4, yani S octet se 4 electrons zyada rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: From the Lewis structures of SO₄²⁻, we can calculate the number of electrons around the central S atom.

blocks.prompt:
15 How do d orbitals allow sulfur to form more bonds than its ground state suggests?
(d orbitals sulfur ko ground state se zyada bonds banane ki ijazat kaise dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ground state S mein do unpaired 3p electrons hain. Aik 3p electron 3d mein jaane se chaar unpaired electrons (3s² 3p³ 3d¹, jaise SO₂ mein); aik 3s electron bhi barhane se chhe (3s¹ 3p³ 3d², SO₄²⁻ ke chhe bonds wali haalat). Is se S ki mukhtalif oxidation states samajh aati hain.

book_ref.quote: The presence of d-orbital allows this configuration to extend to 4 unpaired electrons

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: book ka text 4 unpaired electrons kehta hai magar diagram 6 dikhata hai. Dono durust haalatein hain: 4 unpaired SO₂ ke liye aur 6 unpaired SO₄²⁻ ke chhe bonds ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
16 Calculate the number of electrons around the central iodine in I₃⁻.
(I₃⁻ mein darmiyani iodine ke gird electrons ki tadaad maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Darmiyani I ke 2 single bonds aur 3 lone pairs hain. Electrons = 2(2) + 2(3) = 4 + 6 = 10. Yani octet 2 electrons se phail jaata hai.

book_ref.quote: In the same way, we can calculate the number of valence electrons around the central iodine atom in the tri-iodide ion.

blocks.prompt:
17 Using the chapter's counting method, find the number of electrons around Xe in XeF₄.
(Chapter ke tareeqe se XeF₄ mein Xe ke gird electrons ginein.)
blocks.explanation: Xe ke 4 single bonds aur 2 lone pairs hain. Electrons = 2(4) + 2(2) = 8 + 4 = 12, yani octet se 4 zyada (expanded octet).

book_ref.quote: XeF₄ is an AB₆ type molecule with four bond pairs and two lone pairs.

blocks.text: 3.2 Electronegativity and the type of bond

blocks.prompt:
18 How does electronegativity difference decide the type of bond?
(Electronegativity ka farq bond ki qisam kaise tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Farq 0.4 se kam: khalis (non-polar) covalent bond; 0.4 aur 1.8 ke darmiyan: polar covalent bond; 1.8 se zyada: ionic bond. Farq jitna zyada, bond utna polar.

book_ref.quote: The difference in electronegativity of two bonded atoms provides an approximate measure of the bond polarity

blocks.prompt:
19 Electronegativities Mg = 1.2 and O = 3.5 (given). Predict the type of bond in MgO.
(Electronegativities Mg = 1.2 aur O = 3.5 (diye gaye). MgO mein bond ki qisam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq = 3.5 − 1.2 = 2.3. Yeh 1.8 se zyada hai, is liye MgO ka bond ionic hai.

book_ref.quote: This is why H-H bond is purely non-polar, H-Cl a polar covalent bond, whereas NaCl is an ionic compound.

blocks.prompt:
20 Electronegativities H = 2.1, O = 3.5 and Br = 2.8 (given). Which bond is more polar, O–H or H–Br?
(Electronegativities H = 2.1, O = 3.5, Br = 2.8 (diye gaye). O–H aur H–Br mein zyada polar kaunsa hai?)
blocks.explanation: O–H: 3.5 − 2.1 = 1.4; H–Br: 2.8 − 2.1 = 0.7. Dono polar covalent (0.4-1.8) hain, magar O–H ka farq zyada hai, is liye woh zyada polar hai.

book_ref.quote: When it is large, the bond is polar covalent or ionic.

blocks.text: Dipole moment and polarity of molecules

blocks.prompt:
21 What does the dipole moment of a molecule measure? What does a higher value indicate?
(Molecule ka dipole moment kya naapta hai? Zyada qeemat kya zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dipole moment bond ya molecule ki polarity ka adadi paimana hai (dipole ke aik hisse par δ⁺ aur doosre par δ⁻). Yeh Debye (D) mein naapa jaata hai; zyada dipole moment zyada polarity zahir karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a quantitative measurement of the polarity of a bond or a molecule.

blocks.prompt:
22 Why does HF have partial charges on its atoms? Which way is its dipole moment directed?
(HF ke atoms par partial charges kyun hain? Is ka dipole moment kis taraf hai?)
blocks.explanation: H aur F mukhtalif elements hain, is liye electrons ki taqseem barabar nahi: F (zyada electronegative) par δ⁻ aur H par δ⁺. Dipole moment positive sire se negative sire ki taraf, yani H se F ki taraf hai.

book_ref.quote: In compounds such as HF, where the bonded atoms are from different elements

blocks.prompt:
23 How does the dipole moment of water prove that it is not linear?
(Paani ka dipole moment kaise sabit karta hai ke yeh linear nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Linear H–O–H ka dipole moment zero hota kyun ke do bond moments khatam ho jaate. Paani ka dipole moment 1.85 D hai, yani bond moments khatam nahi hote: paani non-linear (v-shaped) hai.

book_ref.quote: The non-zero dipole moment value shows that water is a non-linear molecule.

blocks.prompt:
24 BeCl₂ has polar bonds but zero dipole moment. Explain.
(BeCl₂ ke bonds polar hain magar dipole moment zero hai. Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: BeCl₂ linear hai, Be ke dono taraf 180° par aik jaise Cl atoms. Do Be–Cl bond moments barabar aur ulat simt mein hain, is liye khatam ho jaate hain: kul dipole moment zero.

book_ref.quote: The individual Be-Cl bond moments are cancelled out as they are opposite in direction and equal in amount.

blocks.prompt:
25 Is SO₂ polar? What does its dipole moment show about its shape?
(Kya SO₂ polar hai? Is ka dipole moment is ki shakal ke baare mein kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haan. SO₂ ka dipole moment 1.61 D hai (paani ke ulat simt mein). Non-zero dipole moment batata hai ke S=O bond moments khatam nahi hote, is liye SO₂ angular (v-shaped) hai, linear nahi.

book_ref.quote: In contrast, SO₂ has a dipole moment of 1.61 D and in opposite direction to that in water.

blocks.prompt:
26 Differentiate between polar and non-polar molecules with examples.
(Polar aur non-polar molecules mein misalon ke saath farq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Polar molecules ka kul dipole moment hota hai; non-polar molecules ka kul dipole moment zero hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Higher dipole moment indicates high polarity in a molecule.

rows: Kul dipole moment hota hai.
Kul dipole moment zero hota hai.
Bond moments khatam nahi hote (ghair-mutawazin, maslan bent shakal).
Symmetrical banawat ki wajah se bond moments khatam ho jaate hain.
Misalein: HF, H₂O (1.85 D), SO₂ (1.61 D), H₂S.
Misalein: BeCl₂, BF₃, CCl₄.

blocks.text: 3.3.2 Valence shell electron pair repulsion model (VSEPR)

blocks.prompt:
27 What is the basic assumption of the VSEPR model?
(VSEPR model ka bunyadi mafrooza kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molecule aisi shakal leta hai jis mein central atom ke valence electron pairs ki repulsion kam se kam ho. Is ke liye pairs zyada se zyada door hote hain aur yahi tarteeb geometry tay karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is based on the assumption that a molecule will take a shape such that the electronic repulsions

blocks.prompt:
28 Why do lone pairs exert greater repulsion than bond pairs?
(Lone pairs bond pairs se zyada repulsion kyun karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lone pair aik hi nucleus se bandha hota hai, jab ke bond pair do nuclei mein shared hota hai. Is liye lone pairs zyada jagah gherte hain aur bond pairs ko dabate hain. Tarteeb: lp-lp > lp-bp > bp-bp.

book_ref.quote: As a result, the non-bonding electron pairs exert greater repulsive forces on bonding electron pairs

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between electron pair geometry and the shape of a molecule.
(Electron pair geometry aur molecule ki shakal mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Electron pair geometry saare pairs ginti hai; shakal sirf atoms ko.

book_ref.quote: The electron pair geometry of a molecule is determined by the total number of electron pairs around

rows: Central atom ke gird kul electron pairs (bond pairs + lone pairs) se tay hoti hai.
Sirf atoms ki jagah se tay hoti hai, lone pairs ko chhor kar.
NH₃: tetrahedral.
NH₃: pyramidal.
H₂O: tetrahedral.
H₂O: angular (v-shaped).

blocks.prompt:
30 Give the steps used to predict the shape of a molecule by the VSEPR model.
(VSEPR model se molecule ki shakal maloom karne ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Central atom chunein: sab se kam electronegative ya sab se kam atoms wala element (CCl₄ mein C). (2) Us ke gird saare electron pairs (bond + lone) ginein. (3) Kul pairs se electron pair geometry. (4) Lone pairs ko chhor kar asal shakal.

book_ref.quote: The following steps are followed to predict the shape of a molecule.

blocks.prompt:
31 How are multiple bonds treated in the VSEPR model? Give an example.
(VSEPR model mein multiple bonds ko kaise gina jaata hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Double bond ke do pairs (ya triple ke teen) mein charge density zyada hai magar unhein aik pair gina jaata hai. Is liye SO₃ ke teen S=O bonds teen pairs gine jaate hain aur yeh bilkul trigonal (120°) hai.

book_ref.quote: The two electron pairs of a double bond and three electron pairs of a triple bond

blocks.prompt:
32 Why is SnCl₂ v-shaped although it has three electron pairs around Sn?
(SnCl₂ ke Sn ke gird teen electron pairs hain phir bhi yeh v-shaped kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sn ke 4 bairooni electrons hain; do Cl se bonds banate hain aur baaqi do lone pair hain. Lone pair tikon ka aik kona gherta hai, is liye use chhor kar shakal v-shaped aur angle 120° se kam hai.

book_ref.quote: One of the corners of the triangle is occupied by this lone pair

blocks.prompt:
33 Why is the bond angle of NH₃ 107° instead of 109.5°?
(NH₃ ka bond angle 109.5° ke bajaye 107° kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: NH₃ mein N ke gird teen bond pairs aur aik lone pair hai (AB₄ type). Lone pair bond pairs ko zyada dafa karta hai (lp-bp > bp-bp) aur dabata hai, is liye angle 109.5° se 107° reh jaata hai aur shakal triangular pyramidal ho jaati hai.

book_ref.quote: This effect compels ammonia to assume a triangular pyramidal shape with reduced bond angles

blocks.prompt:
34 Why is the bond angle of NF₃ (102.5°) smaller than that of NH₃ (107°)?
(NF₃ ka bond angle (102.5°) NH₃ (107°) se chhota kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Bahut polar N–F bonds ki wajah se N lone pair ko apne nucleus ke qareeb kheenchta hai, aur lone pair bond pairs ko zyada dafa karta hai. (ii) N–F bond pairs N ke bajaye F ke qareeb hain; faasla barhne se un ki aapas ki repulsion kamzor hoti hai aur bonds qareeb aa jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: The first reason being the strong polarity of N-F bond, due to which N atom pulls the lone pair closer to its nucleus.

blocks.prompt:
35 Explain why H₂O is v-shaped with a bond angle of 104.5°.
(H₂O ke v-shaped hone aur 104.5° angle ki wajah bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: H₂O ke chaar electron pairs hain (tetrahedral geometry): do konon par lone pairs aur do par bond pairs. Lone pairs ko chhor kar shakal angular (v-shaped) hai. Do lone pairs ki zyada repulsion angle ko 104.5° kar deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Two of the corners of the tetrahedron are occupied by two lone pairs and the remaining two by bond pairs.

blocks.prompt:
36 Compare the shapes of H₃O⁺ and NH₂⁻ using VSEPR.
(VSEPR se H₃O⁺ aur NH₂⁻ ki shakalon ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono AB₄ type hain aur electron pair geometry tetrahedral hai, magar lone pairs mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: The hydronium ion [H₃O]⁺ is formed when a water molecule captures a proton.

rows: O par teen bond pairs aur aik lone pair.
N par do bond pairs aur do lone pairs.
Trigonal pyramidal, NH₃ jaisa.
Bent (v-shaped), H₂O jaisa.

blocks.prompt:
37 Describe the positions of atoms in the trigonal bipyramidal PCl₅ molecule.
(Trigonal bipyramidal PCl₅ molecule mein atoms ki jagahein bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Teen Cl atoms aik planar tikon ke konon par hain (angles 120°) aur do plane ke amoodi axis par, aik upar aur aik neeche. Axial aur planar atom ka angle 90° hai.

book_ref.quote: In a trigonal bipyramid, three positions lie along the corners of the planar triangle

blocks.prompt:
38 Why is the tri-iodide ion linear although it is an AB₅ system?
(Tri-iodide ion AB₅ system hone ke bawajood linear kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Darmiyani I ke gird paanch pairs hain: do bond pairs aur teen lone pairs, is liye geometry trigonal bipyramidal hai. Teen lone pairs trigonal plane mein aur do I atoms axis par upar neeche hain, is liye lone pairs chhor kar shakal linear (180°) hai.

book_ref.quote: Tri-iodide ion [I₃]⁻ is linear, although it is an AB₅ system.

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between the shapes of SF₆ and XeF₄.
(SF₆ aur XeF₄ ki shakalon mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ke chhe electron pairs hain (AB₆, octahedral geometry), magar XeF₄ par do lone pairs hain.

book_ref.quote: In this geometry, four electron pairs are at the corners of a planar square

rows: Chhe bond pairs, koi lone pair nahi.
Chaar bond pairs aur do lone pairs (180° par).
Shakal octahedral.
Shakal square planar.
Saare F–S–F angles 90°.
Saare F–Xe–F angles 90°.

blocks.prompt:
40 How many corners, faces, edges and bond angles does a tetrahedral shape have?
(Tetrahedral shakal ke kitne kone, faces, edges aur bond angles hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tetrahedron ke chaar kone, chaar faces, chhe edges aur chhe bond angles hote hain, har aik ideal taur par 109.5°.

book_ref.quote: The tetrahedral shape has four corners, four faces, six edges and six bond angles.

blocks.prompt:
41 Why are CH₄, SiH₄ and CCl₄ tetrahedral?
(CH₄, SiH₄ aur CCl₄ tetrahedral kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har central atom ke chaar bond pairs hain aur koi lone pair nahi (AB₄). Chaar pairs repulsion se bachne ke liye regular tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hote hain, is liye har angle 109.5° hai.

book_ref.quote: On the same grounds, SiH₄, GeH₄, CCl₄ possess the similar shape.

blocks.text: 3.3.3 Applications of the VSEPR model in drug designing

blocks.prompt:
42 Define drug, target and ligand.
(Drug, target aur ligand ki definitions likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Drug: kimiyai cheez jo bimari se bachaye, tashkhees kare ya ilaaj kare. Target (substrate): jism ka khaas maqam ya amal jis se drug amal karti hai, maslan enzymes, proteins, nucleic acids. Ligand: drug ka bioactive molecule jo target se jurta hai.

book_ref.quote: Drugs interact with human body at specific points, or with specific processes called targets or substrates

blocks.prompt:
43 Why is molecular shape important in drug design?
(Drug design mein molecular shakal kyun aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf munasib shakal wale ligands target ki active site mein fit hote hain, jaise khaas chabi khaas taale mein. VSEPR substrate recognition, ligand specificity aur antibody recognition ke liye shakalein maloom karne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Molecular shape is an important feature that determines how a drug interacts with a biological target.

blocks.prompt:
44 How does aspirin relieve pain?
(Aspirin dard kaise kam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aspirin apne acetyl group (–OCCH₃) se enzyme COX (cyclooxygenase) ki active site se jurti hai. Dono ki shakalein mutabiq hain, is liye binding kamyab hoti hai aur COX ruk jaata hai, jo dard ki wajah hai.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, the binding is successful to block COX, which is a cause of the pain in the body.

blocks.text: 3.4 Valence bond theory (VBT)

blocks.prompt:
45 State any three postulates of valence bond theory.
(Valence bond theory ke koi teen postulates likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Covalent bond tab banta hai jab do atoms ke milti energy wale aadhe bhare valence orbitals overlap karein. (2) Zyada overlap, mazboot bond. (3) Covalent bonds simt rakhte hain; simt orbitals ki shakal aur overlap ke tareeqe se tay hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: VBT is concerned with both the formation of bonds and the shapes of molecules.

blocks.prompt:
46 Why is VBT considered better than the VSEPR model?
(VBT ko VSEPR model se behtar kyun samjha jaata hai?)
blocks.explanation: VSEPR shakalein batata hai magar bond banne ki wajah nahi deta. VBT bond banna (aadhe bhare orbitals ke overlap se) aur shakal dono samjhati hai.

book_ref.quote: This method of describing a covalent bond considers a molecule as a combination of atoms.

blocks.text: 3.4.1 Formation of sigma bond

blocks.prompt:
47 What is a sigma bond? Name the types of overlap that form it, with one example each.
(Sigma bond kya hai? Is ko banane wale overlaps ke naam aur har aik ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Sigma bond do qareebi atoms ke aadhe bhare orbitals ke nuclear axis par seedhe (head-on) overlap se banta hai. s-s overlap: H₂; s-p overlap: HCl; p-p overlap: Cl₂.

book_ref.quote: Both s and p orbitals can overlap head-on to form sigma bonds.

blocks.prompt:
48 Why is the electron density in H₂ symmetrical while that in HCl is not?
(H₂ mein electron density yaksan aur HCl mein ghair-yaksan kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: H₂ mein do aik jaise H atoms ke s orbitals overlap karte hain, is liye electrons dono nuclei ke gird yaksan hain. HCl mein H ka s orbital Cl ke p orbital se milta hai; Cl zyada electronegative hai, is liye density Cl ke qareeb zyada hai aur HCl polar hai.

book_ref.quote: After the bond formation, the electrons are paired up and the electron density in this molecule is symmetrical

blocks.prompt:
49 How is the H₂S molecule formed according to VBT? What is its bond angle?
(VBT ke mutabiq H₂S molecule kaise banta hai? Is ka bond angle kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: S ke do aadhe bhare 3p orbitals (3py aur 3pz) do H atoms ke 1s orbitals se overlap kar ke do σ bonds banate hain. Molecule v-shaped hai aur angle 92° hai.

book_ref.quote: The two 3p (say 3py and 3pz) orbitals of sulfur containing one electron each

blocks.prompt:
50 Why is the bond angle in H₂S (92°) smaller than in H₂O (104.5°)?
(H₂S ka bond angle (92°) H₂O (104.5°) se chhota kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq S ke orbitals bare hain aur lone pair bond pairs par zyada repulsion daalta hai, is liye H–S–H angle 92° tak dab jaata hai.

book_ref.quote: The bond angle in H₂O is 104.5°, whereas in H₂S, it is 92°.

blocks.prompt:
51 In O₂, why do the py orbitals form a π bond and not a σ bond?
(O₂ mein py orbitals σ ke bajaye π bond kyun banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: px orbitals ke nuclear axis par seedhe overlap (σ bond) ke baad dono atoms ke py orbitals aapas mein mutawazi hote hain. Yeh sirf pehlu se overlap kar sakte hain, lobes nuclei ke plane ke upar aur neeche, jis se π bond banta hai.

book_ref.quote: However, the py orbitals on both atoms are aligned parallel to each other.

blocks.text: 3.5 Atomic orbital hybridization and shapes of molecules

blocks.prompt:
52 Define hybridization. State two conditions for it.
(Hybridization ki definition likhein. Is ki do sharait batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Hybridization thori mukhtalif energy aur shakal wale atomic orbitals ko mila kar barabar energy aur shakal wale naye orbitals banana hai. Sharait: yeh aik hi atom (ya ion) mein hota hai, aur sirf qareebi energy wale orbitals milte hain.

book_ref.quote: A process in which atomic orbitals of slightly different energies and shapes are mixed together

blocks.prompt:
53 How many hybrid orbitals are formed in sp, sp² and sp³ hybridization? Give the rule.
(sp, sp² aur sp³ hybridization mein kitne hybrid orbitals bante hain? Usool batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Milne wale orbitals ki tadaad hamesha hybrid orbitals ke barabar hai. sp: 1 + 1 = 2; sp²: 1 + 2 = 3; sp³: 1 + 3 = 4.

book_ref.quote: The number of mixing orbitals is always equal to the number of the resulting hybrid orbitals.

blocks.text: 3.5.1 Types of hybridization

blocks.prompt:
54 How is methane formed by sp³ hybridization?
(sp³ hybridization se methane kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon mein aik 2s aur teen 2p orbitals (excited state) mil kar chaar barabar sp³ orbitals banate hain jo tetrahedral hain. Har aik H ke 1s se overlap kar ke chaar sp³-s σ bonds banata hai jo regular tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf hain (109.5°).

book_ref.quote: The four new hybrid orbitals of equal energy have a tetrahedral geometry with carbon nucleus at the center.

blocks.prompt:
55 Describe the shape of an sp³ hybrid orbital.
(sp³ hybrid orbital ki shakal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har sp³ hybrid orbital ke do lobes hain, aik bara aur aik chhota. Saadgi ke liye chaar sp³ orbitals ko saath dikhate waqt chhota lobe aksar nahi banaya jaata.

book_ref.quote: For the sake of simplicity, the smaller lobe is usually not shown

blocks.prompt:
56 Explain sp² hybridization in BF₃.
(BF₃ mein sp² hybridization bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Excited B mein aik 2s aur do 2p orbitals mil kar teen aadhe bhare sp² orbitals banate hain jo aik plane mein 120° par hain. Har aik F ke aadhe bhare 2pz se overlap karta hai, is liye BF₃ triangular planar hai aur angles 120° hain.

book_ref.quote: The three outermost orbitals of B mix together to give three sp² hybrid orbitals.

blocks.prompt:
57 Explain sp hybridization in BeCl₂.
(BeCl₂ mein sp hybridization bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Excited Be mein aik 2s aur aik 2p orbital mil kar do barabar sp orbitals banate hain jo 180° par hain. Har aik Cl ke aadhe bhare p orbital se overlap karta hai, is liye BeCl₂ linear hai.

book_ref.quote: The sp hybridization explains the geometry of linear molecules such as beryllium chloride

blocks.prompt:
58 Differentiate between sp² and sp³ hybridization.
(sp² aur sp³ hybridization mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: sp² mein aik s aur do p, aur sp³ mein aik s aur teen p orbitals milte hain.

book_ref.quote: In sp² hybridization, one s and two p atomic orbitals of an atom intermix to form three orbitals

rows: Aik s aur do p orbitals milte hain.
Aik s aur teen p orbitals milte hain.

Chaar hybrid orbitals.

Tetrahedral, 109.5°.

Misaal: CH₄.

blocks.text: 3.6 Molecular orbital theory (MOT)

blocks.prompt:
59 What does a bond order of zero mean? Give an example from the chapter.
(Zero bond order ka kya matlab hai? Chapter se misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Bond order = (a − b)/2 do atoms ke darmiyan bonds ki tadaad hai. Zero ka matlab bonding aur anti-bonding electrons barabar hain, koi bond nahi banta aur molecule wujood nahi rakhta. Misaal: He₂, (2 − 2)/2 = 0.

book_ref.quote: The number of bonds formed between two atoms after the atomic orbitals overlap, is called the bond order

blocks.prompt:
60 Differentiate between bonding and anti-bonding molecular orbitals.
(Bonding aur anti-bonding molecular orbitals mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Bonding MOs aik jaise sign ke overlap se aur kam energy ke; anti-bonding MOs mukhalif sign ke overlap se aur zyada energy ke hote hain.

book_ref.quote: When same sign orbitals overlap, the bonding molecular orbital

rows: Aik jaise sign wale orbitals ke overlap se.
Mukhalif sign wale orbitals ke overlap se.
Parent atomic orbitals se kam energy.
Parent atomic orbitals se zyada energy.
Nishan σ ya π.
Nishan σ* ya π*.
H₂ mein: nuclear axis ke gird yaksan.
H₂ mein: electron density nuclei se door.

blocks.prompt:
61 A diatomic species has 6 bonding and 4 anti-bonding electrons. Find its bond order.
(Aik diatomic species mein 6 bonding aur 4 anti-bonding electrons hain. Is ka bond order maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Bond order = (a − b)/2 = (6 − 4)/2 = 1. Atoms aik bond se jure hain.

book_ref.quote: The molecular orbital approach explains the results of quantum mechanical calculations for covalent bonding.

blocks.prompt:
62 How are π molecular orbitals formed? Where is their electron density?
(π molecular orbitals kaise bante hain? Un ki electron density kahan hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab mutawazi axes wale py ya pz orbitals pehlu se milte hain to π MOs bante hain. Bonding π(2py), π(2pz) ki nuclear axis par density zero (nodal plane) hai; anti-bonding π*(2py), π*(2pz) ki nuclei ke darmiyani hisse mein density sab se kam hai.

book_ref.quote: anti-bonding molecular orbitals π*(2py) and π*(2pz) have the least electron density in the inter-nuclear region

blocks.prompt:
63 Differentiate between the head-on and sideways approach of p orbitals in MOT.
(MOT mein p orbitals ki head-on aur sideways approach mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Head-on approach se σ MOs aur sideways approach se π MOs bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Here, the p-orbitals of the two atoms approach along the same axis

rows: p orbitals aik hi axis (x-axis) par aate hain.
p orbitals (py ya pz) ke axes mutawazi hain.
σ(2px) aur σ*(2px) MOs bante hain.
π(2py), π(2pz) aur π*(2py), π*(2pz) MOs bante hain.

blocks.text: 3.6.1 Molecular orbital diagrams of some diatomic molecules and their bond orders

blocks.prompt:
64 Why does He₂ not exist according to MOT?
(MOT ke mutabiq He₂ kyun nahi banta?)
blocks.explanation: Do He atoms (1s²) ke 4 electrons: do σ1s mein aur do σ*1s mein. Bond order = (2 − 2)/2 = 0. Zero bond order par bond nahi banta, is liye He₂ nahi banta.

book_ref.quote: Out of four electrons, two enter the bonding molecular orbital

blocks.prompt:
65 Relate the bond orders of N₂ and O₂ to their bond energies in Table 3.2.
(N₂ aur O₂ ke bond orders ko Table 3.2 ki bond energies se jorein.)
blocks.explanation: N₂: bond order (6 − 0)/2 = 3 (N≡N), bond energy 941 kJ mol⁻¹. O₂: bond order (6 − 2)/2 = 2 (O=O), bond energy 495 kJ mol⁻¹. N₂ ka zyada bond order us ki bahut zyada bond energy ke saath hai, kyun ke multiple bonds zyada mazboot hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, there are three covalent bonds between the nitrogen atoms in this molecule.

blocks.prompt:
66 What are paramagnetic substances? Why is O₂ paramagnetic?
(Paramagnetic cheezein kya hain? O₂ paramagnetic kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paramagnetic cheezein magnetic field ki taraf khinchti hain; un mein aik ya zyada unpaired electrons hote hain. O₂ ke MO diagram mein do unpaired electrons hain, aik π*(2py) aur aik π*(2pz) mein, jo O₂ ko magnetic field dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Paramagnetic substances have one or more unpaired electrons in them.

blocks.prompt:
67 Calculate the bond order of O₂ and state what it shows.
(O₂ ka bond order maloom karein aur batayein yeh kya zahir karta hai.)
blocks.explanation: 2p molecular orbitals se: bonding electrons 6, anti-bonding 2. Bond order = (6 − 2)/2 = 2: aik σ aur aik π bond, yani O=O double bond.

book_ref.quote: The bond order of oxygen is 2

blocks.prompt:
68 Differentiate between the energy order of the 2p molecular orbitals in N₂ and O₂.
(N₂ aur O₂ ke 2p molecular orbitals ki energy tarteeb mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: σ2px ki jagah π2p orbitals ke muqable mein mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: whereas, 2p orbitals give six molecular orbitals which are arranged in the increasing order of energy as

rows: π2py = π2pz, σ2px se neeche hain.
σ2px, π2py = π2pz se neeche hai.
σ2s < σ*2s < π2py = π2pz < σ2px < π*2py = π*2pz < σ*2px
σ2s < σ*2s < σ2px < π2py = π2pz < π*2py = π*2pz < σ*2px

blocks.prompt:
69 Why does liquid oxygen get suspended between the poles of a strong magnet?
(Liquid oxygen taaqatwar magnet ke poles ke darmiyan kyun latak jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: O₂ mein do unpaired electrons (π*2py aur π*2pz mein) hain, is liye us ka apna magnetic field hai jo bairooni field se amal karta hai. Paramagnetic hone ki wajah se liquid O₂ khinch kar poles ke darmiyan ruk jaati hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to the presence of these unpaired electrons, oxygen molecule has a net magnetic field

blocks.text: 3.7 Intermolecular forces

blocks.prompt:
70 What are van der Waals forces? Name their three types.
(Van der Waals forces kya hain? In ki teen qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Van der Waals (intermolecular) forces har qisam ke atoms aur molecules ke darmiyan kamzor kashish hain jab woh kaafi qareeb hon; yeh molecules ko qareeb laati aur physical properties deti hain. Qismein: (1) London dispersion (instantaneous dipole-induced dipole) forces, (2) permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces, (3) hydrogen bonding.

book_ref.quote: These forces are believed to exist between all kinds of atoms and molecules when they are sufficiently close

blocks.text: 3.9 Bond energy and bond length

blocks.prompt:
71 Define bond energy. How is it determined and what is its unit?
(Bond energy ki definition likhein. Yeh kaise maloom hoti hai aur is ki unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bond energy kisi cheez ke aik mole mein aik qisam ke saare bonds torne ki ausat energy hai. Yeh reaction mein shamil heat naap kar maloom ki jaati hai; unit kJ mol⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: It is determined experimentally by measuring the heat involved in a chemical reaction

blocks.prompt:
72 Why is the bond energy of H–F (565 kJ mol⁻¹) greater than that of H–I (295 kJ mol⁻¹)?
(H–F ki bond energy (565 kJ mol⁻¹) H–I (295 kJ mol⁻¹) se zyada kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: H aur F ki electronegativity ka farq H aur I se bahut zyada hai. Zyada farq se zyada polarity, jo atoms mein izafi kashish deti hai, is liye H–F mazboot hai (565 − 295 = 270 kJ mol⁻¹ zyada).

book_ref.quote: The data show that the bond energy of a bond rises with the increasing electronegativity difference

blocks.prompt:
73 Using Table 3.2, find the energy needed to break all H–Cl bonds in 3 mol of HCl.
(Table 3.2 se, 3 mol HCl ke saare H–Cl bonds torne ke liye energy maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: H–Cl bond energy = 427 kJ mol⁻¹. Energy = 3 mol × 427 kJ mol⁻¹ = 1281 kJ.

book_ref.quote: Look at the bond energies of H-X type of compounds, where X=F, Cl, Br, I.

blocks.prompt:
74 Name the factors on which the strength (bond energy) of a bond depends.
(Bond ki mazbooti (bond energy) kin awaamil par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: (1) Bonded atoms ki electronegativity ka farq: zyada farq, zyada bond energy. (2) Atoms ka size. Multiple bonds bhi single se mazboot hain: C≡C (839) > C=C (614) > C–C (347) kJ mol⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Electronegativity difference of bonded atoms

blocks.prompt:
75 Define bond length. Name the techniques used to find it.
(Bond length ki definition likhein. Ise maloom karne ke tareeqe batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Bond length covalent bond banane wale do atoms ke nuclei ka darmiyani faasla hai. Yeh electron diffraction, X-ray diffraction ya spectral studies se maloom hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Bond length is the distance between the nuclei of two atoms forming a covalent bond.

blocks.prompt:
76 Why is the C–Cl bond (180 pm) longer than the C–F bond (135 pm)?
(C–Cl bond (180 pm) C–F bond (135 pm) se lamba kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Atoms ka size barhne se bond length barhti hai. Cl atom F se bahut bara hai, is liye C–Cl bond lamba hai (180 − 135 = 45 pm).

book_ref.quote: This is because the Cl atom is much larger.

blocks.prompt:
77 The Si–F bond in SiF₄ is about 155 pm, while covalent radii (Si = 117 pm, F = 64 pm) predict 181 pm. Find the shortening and give its reason.
(SiF₄ mein Si–F bond taqreeban 155 pm hai, jab ke covalent radii (Si = 117 pm, F = 64 pm) se 181 pm aata hai. Kami maloom karein aur wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Mutawaqqa = 117 + 64 = 181 pm; kami = 181 − 155 = 26 pm (taqreeban 14%). Electronegativity ka bara farq bond ko ionic character deta hai, jis ki izafi kashish bond ko chhota karti hai.

book_ref.quote: With the rise in electronegativity difference between the bonded atoms, the bond becomes shortened.

blocks.prompt:
78 Compare bond energy and bond length of C–C, C=C and C≡C using Tables 3.2 and 3.3.
(Tables 3.2 aur 3.3 se C–C, C=C aur C≡C ki bond energy aur bond length ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Single se triple bond tak bond energy barhti aur length ghatti hai: C–C 347 kJ mol⁻¹, 154 pm; C=C 614 kJ mol⁻¹, 133 pm; C≡C 839 kJ mol⁻¹, 120 pm. Triple bond sab se mazboot aur chhota hai.

book_ref.quote: The bond lengths are experimentally determined by physical techniques

blocks.prompt:
79 Differentiate between bond energy and bond length.
(Bond energy aur bond length mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Bond energy aik energy hai; bond length aik faasla hai.

book_ref.quote: Bond energy is a measure of the strength of a bond and its reactivity.

blocks.text: 3.10 A comparison among ionic, covalent, metallic bonds and intermolecular forces

blocks.prompt:
80 Why are ionic, covalent and metallic bonds termed true chemical bonds?
(Ionic, covalent aur metallic bonds ko asal chemical bonds kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh cheez ki chemical properties par asar daalte hain: electrons ki muntaqili aur sharing se nayi species banate hain. Intermolecular forces sirf molecules ko qareeb laati hain aur physical properties par asar daalti hain.

book_ref.quote: Chemical bonds, i.e. ionic, covalent, and metallic bond are usually termed as true chemical bonds

blocks.prompt:
81 Differentiate between chemical bonds and intermolecular forces.
(Chemical bonds aur intermolecular forces mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Chemical bonds nayi species banate hain aur mazboot hain; intermolecular forces molecules ke darmiyan aur kamzor hain.

book_ref.quote: It also reveals that chemical bonds are generally much stronger than intermolecular forces.

rows: Electrons ki muntaqili aur sharing se nayi species banate hain.
Molecules ko qareeb laati hain.
Chemical properties par asar.
Physical properties par asar.
Mazboot: NaCl ionic 760, O–H 464 kJ mol⁻¹.
Kamzor: hydrogen bonding 20-50, van der Waals 1-20 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
82 Why is the metallic bond weaker than ionic and covalent bonds?
(Metallic bond ionic aur covalent bonds se kamzor kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ki ausat bond energy sirf 100-150 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. Is kam mazbooti ki tasalli bakhsh wajah metallic crystal mein electrons ka wasee phailao (delocalization) hai.

book_ref.quote: In any case, the metallic bond is weaker than both the ionic and covalent bonds.

blocks.prompt:
83 Arrange the following in decreasing order of strength using Table 3.4: hydrogen bonding, ionic bond in NaCl, van der Waals forces, O–H bond in water.
(Table 3.4 se in ko mazbooti ki ghatti tarteeb mein likhein: hydrogen bonding, NaCl ka ionic bond, van der Waals forces, paani ka O–H bond.)
blocks.explanation: NaCl ka ionic bond (760) > paani ka O–H bond (464) > hydrogen bonding (20-50) > van der Waals forces (1-20 kJ mol⁻¹).

book_ref.quote: Table 3.4 provides a comparison among different chemical bonds and intermolecular forces.
